judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and a new acceptance test (`src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping completely before modifying any production code. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` was left untouched, meaning the orchestrator still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating `totalUsage`, and the newly added acceptance test immediately fails. It also missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and renaming the hook parameter to `totalUsage`. While the spec edit and test logic accurately reflect the requirements of the ticket, the implementation itself was never carried out.
